name: mcp-yandex-metrica
description: Read Yandex Metrica web analytics from Claude: counters, goals, and traffic and conversion statistics.

token.title: Yandex Metrica OAuth token
token.description: OAuth token for the Yandex Metrica API. Stored in your operating system's credential store, never in settings.json.

counter_id.title: Default counter id
counter_id.description: Counter to use when a request does not name one. Leave empty to choose the counter per request.

telemetry.title: Anonymous telemetry
telemetry.description: Set to 0 to disable the anonymous usage telemetry the server sends by default. Leave as 1 to keep it on.
